tasks.title: Assemble the film edit
tasks.instructions: Assemble approved material into the intended sequence, then prepare a reviewable render for editorial feedback.

criteria.title: Edit structure
criteria.description: The edit follows the approved sequence, preserves narrative clarity and uses transitions that support the intended pacing.

criteria.title: Render review
criteria.description: A review render is checked for missing media, timing errors, audio continuity and unintended black or frozen frames.
